verdicts.originalText: While Stone Armor is up, Noelle's Normal and Charged Attack hits have a ~59% chance to heal the whole party (rising to 100% at C1 while her Elemental Burst is active). The planner shows the heal on every qualifying hit — the actual proc chance is not simulated.
verdicts.proposedText: Shown healing on every qualifying Normal or Charged hit, but each has only a ~59% chance to heal the party — rising to 100% at C1 while the burst is active. The proc chance is not modeled.
verdicts.rationale: The trust-repair is the certainty-vs-chance divergence: the timeline fires the heal on every qualifying Normal/Charged hit, but in game it is a ~59% proc (100% at C1 during the burst). Kept as rewrite (not implementDelete) because there is no probability primitive in the schema — an unmodeled real gap, not a wired capability. Compressed to the 'Shown as X; not modeled' shape, stripped the character name and the summon proper noun ('Stone Armor'), and reduced 'her Elemental Burst' to the bare kind 'the burst' per the name-omission rule. Preserved the 'party' scope word verbatim since the heal effect targets 'team'. The gating clause 'While Stone Armor is up' is demoted — it is a real in-game requirement the tool only approximates via host-ability window scoping, but it is secondary to the proc-chance point and already fully documented in _curatorNotes.
demotedNotes: In game the heal only procs while the skill's Stone Armor shield is active; the tool approximates this via host-ability onHit window scoping (Thoma Crimson Ooyoroi precedent) rather than an explicit shield-up condition, since 'duringSummon' would not resolve for a follows-mobility instant-skill summon.

claimsLost.claim: The heal only procs while the skill's Stone Armor shield is up
